abilitygroupdescription.p: These abilities represent training in the use of axes in combat. This includes the use of single handed war axes, two handed battle axes, and throwing axes.

abilityauxiliary.name: Auxiliary Attack
abilityauxiliary.precondition: The character kills an opponent using an Axe Strike attack.
abilityauxiliary.effect: Axe Strike damage is dealt to an additional enemy adjacent to the attacking character.

abilitydescription.p: The character strikes at their opponent with great vengeance and furious anger. Damage from this attack beyond the amount that kills the target is then applied to all other targets adjacent to the attacker.

For example, suppose Dourli is attacking three goblin. He makes an Axe Strike attack on the first goblin with a righteous success and dealing 18 hit points damage to the goblin. The goblin only has 11 hit points. The overflow damage is 7.

When a character makes a frenzied attack with an axe, they make a Mettle Check. If they pass they may make two standard axe attacks. On a Damned result the character goes beserk. Results can be shifted up in the face of instigating circumstances.

abilitycheck.name: Melee Attack
abilitycheck.precondition: Righteous Axe Strike against an opponent carrying an item, a weapon or shield
abilitycheck.critsuccess: Target drops item, weapon or shield. Attacker chooses.
abilitycheck.success: Target drops random item, weapon or shield

abilitydescription.p: Characters equipped with an axe can use the beard of the axe to attempt to disarm an opponent, remove their shield or hook things out of their hands.
Characters equipped with an axe can strike with it during combat doing weapon damage.
